definitions.Hs: 4*sqrt(sum(amplitude^2/2)), independent phase ensemble, not individual crest-to-trough height
definitions.phaseSpeed: omega/k relative to water; current adds Doppler advection
definitions.groupSpeed: domega/dk of the actual capped-kh gravity-capillary dispersion
definitions.direction: propagation vector (cos angle,sin angle), from+x toward+z; no geographic north mapping

shallowBoundary.warning: A distinct lower-frequency authored system, not an exact duplicate of the7.5s spectrum and not its depth-aware continuation.

nativeHydro.returnedFlow: sampleFlow returns only steady potential-flow current; GPU perturbation u/v is not returned
nativeHydro.clockWarning: Standalone API can drop excess lag, but actual main caps delta0.055s below12*dt. Current host therefore retains analytic/SWE phase to one fixed tick and instead slows the whole scene at low renderHz. Do not claim standalone10Hz lag is an observed host defect.

caustics.filters: geometry footprint0.40m; caustics0.12m or0.32m; optical per-pixel footprint. Shared phases but different deliberate LOD, not identical per-pass shapes.

materialCoupling.sandDirectLighting: shared solar/key caustic concentration multiplies the entire standard-material reflectedLight.directDiffuse including local lights; water custom bedLocal does not have this multiplication.

limits: Numerical/source audit only; no fresh GPU capture, no measuredFPS or subjective visual acceptance.
The physical dispersion table is a small-amplitude diagnostic; rows with Hs/depth near1 are outside the validity of that linear waveform.
Steady projection velocity is an authored tide flow, not solved wave runup/backwash.
The dry boundary gap uses radial coast probes and actual scene terrain; it is not a surveyed real island slope.
